 Procedure

Equipment:Auto Transformer 500/220/11kv
 Single Phase 166.6MVA
 Jeumont Schneider, France

Procedure:
 Equipment Inspections (I2-Y1)
Introduction

This document lists the equipment inspection checklist I2 which must be performed on an annually bases as indicated 
by Y1 in the title block.

The first draft initiated 
by eng. Nachwa Hussein Mostafa, reviewed by eng. Elen Aez: MPIS director at 
Cairo zone, tested at Tibbeen 500 substation by eng. Gamil Abd El Latif Mohamed, 
accepted by eng. Fekry Ebrahim Sallam, certified by EETC Cairo Zone coordinator 
eng. Ahmed Shelaby Faisal general director of EHV North stations, approved by 
eng. Samir Saleh Ismaiel; Cairo zone EHV Head Sector
Safety Precautions

A work permit must be issued and qualified maintenance staff should 
 carry the suitable safety category

Wear 
 your safety helmet, shoes and safety belt when cleaning suspension insulators

Safety 
 fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required

Transformer 
 isolation and proper earthling is required

There 
 is a danger of falling into the containment pit when working near large power 
 transformer

It 
 is recommended to use only fiberglass (PVC) ladders when working in the 
 switchyard

Local 
 grounded must be used

Environmental 
Recommendation

Before starting the 
 cleaning of all porcelain surfaces of all transformer wear your breathing mask 
 to protect lung tissues from the dust particulate

Don't burn the cloth 
 used in cleaning collect it and send it to the dump

Fix any oil leaks to 
 prevent pollution and save money of wasted oil

Oil leaks to the 
 ground have very bad impact on the environment, mainly on soil

Ground water and 
 eventually on the eco-system. "It takes only I liter of hydrocarbon spilled in 
 an aquifer to render 1.000.000 liters of potable water useless for human 
 consumption"

sections.text: Work to be Carried Out

Repeat the previous monthly inspection procedures in document 
 no. T-066-r0

Check all painted surfaces of the transformer, remove signs of 
 rust and repair use rust prevention

Check conditions of earthling bus (system) all bolted connection 
 for tightness
Check pressure relief on main tank and oltc tank

Open bleed valve on bukhloz relay until a small amount of oil 
 escapes test alarm and trip circuit using push button next to valve, check all 
 electrical connections

Check cooling fan and screen for dust accumulation, blade 
 cracks, motor bearing noise and heating (motor or ball bearing). It is 
 recommended to change motor bearing after 3000 running hours or 5 years)

Check main transformer and 
 OLTC control cabinet connections 
 tightness, space heater operation fan control operation, and temp. Setting 
 adjustments, motor operating mechanism

Use a water pressure to clean radiators and transformer tank, 
 walls, unsealed wiring must be covered plastic to avoid short circuit. It is 
 recommended to use the transformer deluge system to perform cleaning 
 operation, it will provide a functioning test for the system at the same 
 time

Take and record insulation resistance readings and compare to 
 the previous test and historical data

Take and record cap. Dissipation factor, tans delta and compare 
 to historical data

Perform ratio test (lowest & highest and neutral tap 
 position and compare to historical data

Perform a complete tap changer OP. From highest to lowest step 
 and back to the position it was found in to clear all internal contacts of tap 
 changer. (This step should be done every 3 Months)

Inspect condition of external tap changer drive shaft, tighten 
 all coup lings and bolted connections

Take and record final reading on tap changer operation 
 counter

Take oil sample for laboratory analysis and gas analysis each 
 for both main and OLTC tanks
